from numpy import array
from PyQt5.uic import loadUi
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMessageBox, QTableWidgetItem
from math import sqrt


def verif():
    ok = True
    if len(win.cin.text()) != 8 or win.cin.text().isdigit() == False:
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur de saisie", "cin invalide")
        ok = False
        win.cin.clear()
    elif win.pos.isChecked() == False and win.neg.isChecked() == False:
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur de saisie", "pcr invalide")
        ok = False
    elif win.ville.currentIndex() == 0:
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur de saisie", "ville invalide")
        ok = False
    elif win.x.text() == "" or win.y.text() == "":
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur de saisie", "position invalide")
        ok = False
    return ok


def ajout():
    global n
    if verif():
        t[n] = {}
        t[n]["cin"] = win.cin.text()
        if win.pos.isChecked() == True:
            t[n]["pcr"] = "+"
        else:
            t[n]["pcr"] = "-"
        t[n]["ville"] = win.ville.currentText()
        t[n]["loc"] = {}
        t[n]["loc"]["x"] = float(win.x.text())
        t[n]["loc"]["y"] = float(win.y.text())
        print(t[n])
        n = n + 1


def recherche_ville():

    if win.ville2.currentIndex() == 0:
        QMessageBox.warning(win, "erreur de saisie", "ville invalide")
    else:
        j = 0
        win.table.setRowCount(0)
        for i in range(n):
            if t[i]["ville"] == win.ville2.currentText() and t[i]["pcr"] == "+":
                win.table.insertRow(j)
                win.table.setItem(j, 0, QTableWidgetItem(t[i]["cin"]))
                win.table.setItem(j, 1, QTableWidgetItem(t[i]["pcr"]))
                win.table.setItem(j, 2, QTableWidgetItem(
                    "(" + str(t[i]["loc"]["x"]) + "," + str(t[i]["loc"]["y"]) + ")"))
                j = j + 1


def recherche_rayon():
    win.list.clear()
    r = win.rayon.text()
    x2 = win.x2.text()
    y2 = win.y2.text()
    if r.isdigit() == False or int(r) <= 0:
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur de saisie", "rayon invalide")
    elif x2 == "" or y2 == "":
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur de saisie", "position invalide")
    else:
        nb = 0
        x2 = float(x2)
        y2 = float(y2)
        r = int(r)
        for i in range(n):
            if t[i]["pcr"] == "+":
                d = sqrt((x2 - t[i]["loc"]["x"]) * (x2 - t[i]["loc"]["x"]) +
                         (y2 - t[i]["loc"]["y"]) * (y2 - t[i]["loc"]["y"]))
                if d <= r:
                    win.list.addItem(t[i]["cin"] + " " + str(d))
                    nb += 1
        win.nb.setText(str(nb))


# PP
n = 0
t = array([{}] * 1000)
app = QApplication([])
win = loadUi("interface_covid.ui")
win.show()
win.btn2.clicked.connect(ajout)
win.btn3.clicked.connect(recherche_ville)
win.btn5.clicked.connect(recherche_rayon)
app.exec_()
